{"type":"thought","data":"The book command failed"}
{"type":"thought","data":" because I used a positional"}
{"type":"thought","data":" argument instead of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the --outcome flag."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nChecking kickoff times"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for the match. Flashscore"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and Goal.com list 08:00."}
{"type":"thought","data":" IDN Times lists 19:00"}
{"type":"thought","data":" WIB. Iddaa lists 15:00"}
{"type":"thought","data":" TSİ. World Soccer Data"}
{"type":"thought","data":" lists 12:00 UTC. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" market closes at 12:00"}
{"type":"thought","data":" UTC."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe market closes "}
{"type":"thought","data":"at kickoff time. Only"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 296 seconds remain."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The best bid is 0.75"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and the best ask is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.77."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nCalculating the payout"}
{"type":"thought","data":" structure. Buying Yes"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at 0.76 means getting"}
{"type":"thought","data":" roughly 131 shares "}
{"type":"thought","data":"for 100 tokens, with"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a profit of about 32"}
{"type":"thought","data":" if they win. The key"}
{"type":"thought","data":" question is whether"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Persija's true win "}
{"type":"thought","data":"probability exceeds "}
{"type":"thought","data":"76%."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nPersija leads the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"league with a perfect"}
{"type":"thought","data":" home record. They have"}
{"type":"thought","data":" won five of their last"}
{"type":"thought","data":" six meetings against"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Persik Kediri, including"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a 3-1 away victory "}
{"type":"thought","data":"last season. Their current"}
{"type":"thought","data":" form and head-to-head"}
{"type":"thought","data":" record suggest a strong"}
{"type":"thought","data":" advantage."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nWinDrawWin predicts"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a 55% home win rate."}
{"type":"thought","data":" That suggests the market's"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 76% price is too high."}
{"type":"thought","data":" A Turkish site model"}
{"type":"thought","data":" gives 78% probability,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" implying roughly 92%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" implied probability."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe 1.09 odds look"}
{"type":"thought","data":" implausibly short for"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a league match, so "}
{"type":"thought","data":"I will check actual "}
{"type":"thought","data":"bookmaker lines on Flashscore,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Oddsportal, and other"}
{"type":"thought","data":" sites. Persija have"}
{"type":"thought","data":" scored 15 goals and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" conceded only 5 in "}
{"type":"thought","data":"six games this season."}
{"type":"thought","data":" They are high-variance"}
{"type":"thought","data":" but strong at home."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Persik Kediri is a "}
{"type":"thought","data":"solid mid-table side"}
{"type":"thought","data":" with a tight defense."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nA 76% win probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" seems too high for "}
{"type":"thought","data":"a home favorite against"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a mid-table opponent."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Historical Liga 1 data shows home win rates"}
{"type":"thought","data":" near 45-50%, with top"}
{"type":"thought","data":" teams at home typically"}
{"type":"thought","data":" around 60-70%. The "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Poisson model estimates"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Persija at roughly "}
{"type":"thought","data":"2.5 goals per game and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.83 against, while"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Persik sits at 1.17"}
{"type":"thought","data":" goals for and 0.67 "}
{"type":"thought","data":"against. Indonesia's"}
{"type":"thought","data":" strong home advantage"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is being factored into"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the expected goal calculation."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nWinDrawWin's 55% home"}
{"type":"thought","data":" win rate would make"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the 76% price a poor"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bet, but that model"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is often conservative"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and not sharp. Bookmaker"}
{"type":"thought","data":" odds are more reliable."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The Turkish site's "}
{"type":"thought","data":"1.09 odds likely reflect"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a data error or a different"}
{"type":"thought","data":" market, since that "}
{"type":"thought","data":"implies roughly 91% "}
{"type":"thought","data":"implied probability."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe 1.09 odds are "}
{"type":"thought","data":"implausibly short for"}
{"type":"thought","data":" this match given Persik's"}
{"type":"thought","data":" defensive record. I"}
{"type":"thought","data":" will check actual lines"}
{"type":"thought","data":" on Oddsportal, Bet365,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Flashscore, and sofascore."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The market's 76% price"}
{"type":"thought","data":" sits between WinDrawWin's"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 55% and the Turkish"}
{"type":"thought","data":" model's 78%. My track"}
{"type":"thought","data":" record shows mixed "}
{"type":"thought","data":"results: I lost several"}
{"type":"thought","data":" draw markets by picking"}
{"type":"thought","data":" No, but I have won "}
{"type":"thought","data":"favorites in past \"will"}
{"type":"thought","data":" X win\" bets and also"}
{"type":"thought","data":" faded favorites successfully."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe phrase \"most likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to pay off\" is ambiguous."}
{"type":"thought","data":" It could mean the outcome"}
{"type":"thought","data":" with the highest probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of being correct, or"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the bet with the highest"}
{"type":"thought","data":" expected value. If "}
{"type":"thought","data":"every agent bets Yes"}
{"type":"thought","data":" because the market "}
{"type":"thought","data":"price implies a 76% "}
{"type":"thought","data":"chance, no one would"}
{"type":"thought","data":" differentiate themselves"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and the competition"}
{"type":"thought","data":" would be meaningless."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe competition is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a head-to-head P&L "}
{"type":"thought","data":"race against the other"}
{"type":"thought","data":" agents. If most competitors"}
{"type":"thought","data":" all bet Yes, they will"}
{"type":"thought","data":" all profit roughly "}
{"type":"thought","data":"31 tokens if Persija"}
{"type":"thought","data":" wins. A lone No bet"}
{"type":"thought","data":" would lose 100 tokens."}
{"type":"thought","data":" But if Persija loses,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" that same No bet would"}
{"type":"thought","data":" return about 316 tokens"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and win the round outright."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The optimal strategy"}
{"type":"thought","data":" depends on both the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" true probability of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a win and what the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"other AI agents are "}
{"type":"thought","data":"likely to do."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nMost agents will likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bet Yes, treating Persija"}
{"type":"thought","data":" as a strong home favorite."}
{"type":"thought","data":" To maximize the chance"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of winning the contest"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rather than just expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value, I should only"}
{"type":"thought","data":" take Yes if my true win probability exceeds roughly 76%. If it sits between 60% and 70%, No becomes the far better choice because of its massive edge and the ability to differentiate from the crowd. I need to fetch sharper odds from multiple bookmakers before deciding."}

{"type":"thought","data":"The decision is clear."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nFair probability from"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Pinnacle is roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 73.3% for a Persija"}
{"type":"thought","data":" win. The market price"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is 0.76, but the ask"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is 0.77. That suggests"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the market is slightly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" overpriced."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nNo has positive expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value at 0.25, while"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Yes is negative at "}
{"type":"thought","data":"0.77. The edge is small."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Kalshi's model also"}
{"type":"thought","data":" shows a 77% chance "}
{"type":"thought","data":"for Persija."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nKalshi likely reflects"}
{"type":"thought","data":" this same market. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 3-4 point gap between"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the fair Pinnacle price"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and the market is within"}
{"type":"thought","data":" normal noise for a "}
{"type":"thought","data":"single match. Most bookmakers"}
{"type":"thought","data":" are calibrated similarly."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nOddsSafari confirms"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the fair probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" near 72.5%. The edge"}
{"type":"thought","data":" on No is real but small."}
{"type":"thought","data":" If the true probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is 0.24, the ask of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.25 makes the bet "}
{"type":"thought","data":"slightly negative EV."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The user asked for "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the outcome most likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to pay off. That favors"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Yes."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe user's goal is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to win. This is a tournament"}
{"type":"thought","data":" scored by profit and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" loss, not just probability."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The agent has a 14-6"}
{"type":"thought","data":" record with an average"}
{"type":"thought","data":" +2.8 per round. Every"}
{"type":"thought","data":" loss costs the full"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 100-token stake."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nI need to check whether"}
{"type":"thought","data":" confidence affects "}
{"type":"thought","data":"payouts or rankings."}
{"type":"thought","data":" If most agents bet "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Yes and the favorite"}
{"type":"thought","data":" wins, they all profit"}
{"type":"thought","data":" similarly and tie. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"The round winner may"}
{"type":"thought","data":" be determined by confidence"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rather than raw P&L."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nIf confidence is only"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a public display and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" does not affect payouts,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" betting the same side"}
{"type":"thought","data":" as rivals would tie."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The user wants the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"outcome most likely "}
{"type":"thought","data":"to pay off, so the best"}
{"type":"thought","data":" expected value bet "}
{"type":"thought","data":"is the right choice."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nStatistical models"}
{"type":"thought","data":" estimate a 55% to 65%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" chance for Persija,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" well below the bookmaker"}
{"type":"thought","data":" fair probability near"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 73%. The gap is explained"}
{"type":"thought","data":" by home advantage. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"GBK and Bung Karno are"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a fortress, and Persija"}
{"type":"thought","data":" has won all three home"}
{"type":"thought","data":" matches this season."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Most models rely on"}
{"type":"thought","data":" small samples of only"}
{"type":"thought","data":" six games, so they "}
{"type":"thought","data":"underweight that quality"}
{"type":"thought","data":" gap. Bookmakers incorporate"}
{"type":"thought","data":" more information including"}
{"type":"thought","data":" team strength and market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" sentiment. Their short"}
{"type":"thought","data":" odds at 1.25 to 1.28"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for a dominant home"}
{"type":"thought","data":" favorite suggest they"}
{"type":"thought","data":" are very confident."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nA quick Poisson model"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is being run to verify"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the 73% fair probability."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The calculation uses"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Persija's home venue"}
{"type":"thought","data":" stats of 2.67 goals"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for and 0.67 against,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" compared with Psim's away figures of 1.00 goals for and 0.67 against."}

{"type":"tool_call","toolCallId":"call-ffe6aa5f-70b7-44ff-93d6-46e25d7ff73c-7","title":"run_terminal_command","kind":"execute","status":"pending","toolName":"run_terminal_command","rawInput":{"command":"python3 - << 'PY'\nimport math\ndef pois(k, lam):\n    return math.exp(-lam) * lam**k / math.factorial(k)\n\ndef match_probs(lh, la, n=12):\n    ph = pd = pa = 0\n    for i in range(n):\n        for j in range(n):\n            p = pois(i, lh) * pois(j, la)\n            if i > j: ph += p\n            elif i == j: pd += p\n            else: pa += p\n    return ph, pd, pa\n\nfor lh, la in [(2.2,1.0),(2.1,0.8),(1.9,0.7),(1.8,0.9),(2.4,0.9),(2.0,0.75),(1.6,0.8),(2.5,0.83)]:\n    ph,pd,pa = match_probs(lh, la)\n    print(f\"lh={lh:.2f} la={la:.2f}  H={ph:.3f} D={pd:.3f} A={pa:.3f}  NoWin={pd+pa:.3f}\")\n\n# pinnacle devig\ndef devig(odds):\n    raw = [1/o for o in odds]\n    s = sum(raw)\n    fair = [r/s for r in raw]\n    print(\"odds\", odds, \"raw\", [round(r,4) for r in raw], \"sum\", round(s,4), \"fair\", [round(f,4) for f in fair])\n\ndevig([1.28, 5.90, 8.67])  # pinnacle\ndevig([1.26, 5.50, 8.36])  # average\ndevig([1.27, 5.25, 7.00])  # bet365 snapshot\ndevig([1.22, 5.40, 9.55])  # 1xbet\ndevig([1.20, 5.50, 9.00])  # betfair\ndevig([1.29, 6.00, 8.00])  # best-ish betway style\n# shin/power method optional\nprint(\"--- market prices ---\")\nprint(\"Yes ask 0.77 EV if p=0.73\", 0.73*(1/0.77-1) - 0.27)\nprint(\"No ask 0.25 EV if p_no=0.27\", 0.27*(1/0.25-1) - 0.73)\nprint(\"Yes ask 0.77 EV if p=0.76\", 0.76*(1/0.77-1) - 0.24)\nprint(\"No ask 0.25 EV if p_no=0.24\", 0.24*(1/0.25-1) - 0.76)\nprint(\"Yes mid 0.76 EV if p=0.73\", 0.73*(1/0.76-1) - 0.27)\nprint(\"No mid 0.24 EV if p_no=0.27\", 0.27*(1/0.24-1) - 0.73)\nPY\nbench bet --help\nbench history --outcome Yes | head -c 4000\necho\necho \"==== NO HIST ====\"\nbench history --outcome No | head -c 2000\necho\nbench market","description":"Compute fair win probs and bet CLI"},"content":[],"locations":[]}

<< 'PY'\nimport math\ndef pois(k, lam):\n    return math.exp(-lam) * lam**k / math.factorial(k)\n\ndef match_probs(lh, la, n=12):\n    ph = pd = pa = 0\n    for i in range(n):\n        for j in range(n):\n            p = pois(i, lh) * pois(j, la)\n            if i > j: ph += p\n            elif i == j: pd += p\n            else: pa += p\n    return ph, pd, pa\n\nfor lh, la in [(2.2,1.0),(2.1,0.8),(1.9,0.7),(1.8,0.9),(2.4,0.9),(2.0,0.75),(1.6,0.8),(2.5,0.83)]:\n    ph,pd,pa = match_probs(lh, la)\n    print(f\"lh={lh:.2f} la={la:.2f}  H={ph:.3f} D={pd:.3f} A={pa:.3f}  NoWin={pd+pa:.3f}\")\n\n# pinnacle devig\ndef devig(odds):\n    raw = [1/o for o in odds]\n    s = sum(raw)\n    fair = [r/s for r in raw]\n    print(\"odds\", odds, \"raw\", [round(r,4) for r in raw], \"sum\", round(s,4), \"fair\", [round(f,4) for f in fair])\n\ndevig([1.28, 5.90, 8.67])  # pinnacle\ndevig([1.26, 5.50, 8.36])  # average\ndevig([1.27, 5.25, 7.00])  # bet365 snapshot\ndevig([1.22, 5.40, 9.55])  # 1xbet\ndevig([1.20, 5.50, 9.00])  # betfair\ndevig([1.29, 6.00, 8.00])  # best-ish betway style\n# shin/power method optional\nprint(\"--- market prices ---\")\nprint(\"Yes ask 0.77 EV if p=0.73\", 0.73*(1/0.77-1) - {"type":"thought","data":"Only about three minutes"}
{"type":"thought","data":" remain to decide."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe No outcome is "}
{"type":"thought","data":"priced at 0.24. My best"}
{"type":"thought","data":" estimate of its probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is about 0.27. This"}
{"type":"thought","data":" gives a thin edge."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nYes is the more probable"}
{"type":"thought","data":" outcome. No offers "}
{"type":"thought","data":"a better expected payoff."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The phrasing \"most "}
{"type":"thought","data":"likely to pay off\" is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" ambiguous."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nMy past record shows"}
{"type":"thought","data":" that fading mispriced"}
{"type":"thought","data":" favorites and backing"}
{"type":"thought","data":" correctly priced ones"}
{"type":"thought","data":" produced the biggest"}
{"type":"thought","data":" wins. The tournament"}
{"type":"thought","data":" goal is to outsmart"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the other agents, who"}
{"type":"thought","data":" will likely all bet"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Yes on the obvious "}
{"type":"thought","data":"favorite."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe tournament scores"}
{"type":"thought","data":" cumulative P&L across"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rounds, not round-by-round"}
{"type":"thought","data":" wins. Betting No would"}
{"type":"thought","data":" give a unique win only"}
{"type":"thought","data":" if Persija loses, but"}
{"type":"thought","data":" that outcome is rare."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The edge is small and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" hinges on the exact"}
{"type":"thought","data":" execution price."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nKalshi sports markets"}
{"type":"thought","data":" are noisier than Pinnacle,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" especially for low-liquidity"}
{"type":"thought","data":" leagues. The 0.76 price"}
{"type":"thought","data":" aligns closely with"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Kalshi's 77% fair estimate,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" suggesting agents may"}
{"type":"thought","data":" be copying that source"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rather than Pinnacle's"}
{"type":"thought","data":" sharper consensus of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" about 73%. If the true"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probability is closer"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to Kalshi's figure,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the No side becomes"}
{"type":"thought","data":" negative expected value."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe market is roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 2 to 6 points richer"}
{"type":"thought","data":" than the books. Buying"}
{"type":"thought","data":" No at 0.25 yields a positive edge of about"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 8 percent. Kelly sizing"}
{"type":"thought","data":" recommends betting "}
{"type":"thought","data":"only 2.7 percent of "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the bankroll. Because"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the fixed stake is "}
{"type":"thought","data":"100 tokens, this amounts"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to an all-in bet. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" expected value is tiny"}
{"type":"thought","data":" but the variance is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" enormous."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nFavorite-longshot "}
{"type":"thought","data":"bias suggests the true"}
{"type":"thought","data":" home win probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" may be higher than "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the devigged 73 percent."}
{"type":"thought","data":" If so, the market price"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of 0.76 would be fair"}
{"type":"thought","data":" or even cheap, making"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the No side negative"}
{"type":"thought","data":" expected value."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nRecent match results"}
{"type":"thought","data":" show Persija in strong"}
{"type":"thought","data":" form, having won both"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of its last two games"}
{"type":"thought","data":" by large margins. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" team has not drawn "}
{"type":"thought","data":"any of its six matches"}
{"type":"thought","data":" this season. Home support at GBK is massive. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"These factors suggest"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a clear favorite rather"}
